cy="@internal How many times a safety system has stopped one of this session's model calls made through the query pipeline (main loop, subagents, forked skills, compaction and other internal calls), as a running total since the session started in this process; two sessions in one process keep separate counts. Counted: a response that ends on stop_reason refusal, whether Claude Code then shows it, retries it or re-sends it to another model; a refusal that the API itself answered on a fallback model; output that the API's content filter stopped for good (the stop ends the call); and, where the build can recognise it (public builds cannot), a server-side safety monitor's block (api_error safety_monitor_blocked). It counts these events, not calls: one call can add a refusal answered on a fallback model and then that model's own refusal. 0 means that none of these was seen; a kind of stop that this version does not know is not counted. Never sum across results. It is never saved, so a resumed session starts at 0 again, and a mid-session /clear zeroes it: over a stored log that spans a restart, a resume or a /clear, any result above 0 means a stop happened, and a later 0 does not cancel it. Present, 0 included, on every result that carries a turn's measured totals. Absent on the zeroed results that stand in for a crashed, cut or never-started turn, on Remote Control's results and from older producers, where it says nothing: absent is not 0. A call still running when a result is written (a background subagent's) shows on the next result; a result held back while background subagents finished carries the count as of when it is written to the stream, never less than it was built with. Not counted inside the pipeline: a stop of the API's content filter that Claude Code answers by streaming the request again (so 0 does not rule one out), an organization's data-loss-prevention denial (api_error dlp_request_denied), a block by a clou
